v.en: O God, come to my assistance;

r.en: O Lord, make haste to help me.

source.scope: Psalmi & antiphonæ ex Psalterio secundum diem

text.en: The Lord hath reigned * let the earth rejoice. ‡

text.la: Te decet hymnus, * Deus, in Sion. ‡
text.en: A hymn, O God, * becometh thee in Sion. ‡

text.la: Tibi, Dómine, psallam, * et intéllegam in via immaculáta.
text.en: I shall sing to thee, O Lord * and I shall understand with a perfect heart.

text.la: Dómine, magnus es tu, * et præclárus in virtúte tua.
text.en: O Lord, great art thou * and glorious in thy power.

text.la: Laudábo Deum meum * in vita mea.
text.en: I shall praise the Lord * in my life.

text.la: Surge, illumináre Ierúsalem, quia venit lumen tuum, et glória Dómini super te orta est.
text.en: Arise, be enlightened, O Jerusalem: for thy light is come, and the glory of the Lord is risen upon thee.

text.la: Maniféste magnum est * pietátis sacraméntum, quod manifestátum est in carne, iustificátum est in spíritu, appáruit Angelis, prædicátum est Géntibus, créditum est in mundo, assúmptum est in glória, allelúia.
text.en: Without controversy * great is the mystery of godliness: God was manifest in the flesh, justified in the Spirit, seen of Angels, preached unto the Gentiles, believed on in the world, received up into glory, alleluia.

text.la: Vota, quǽsumus, Dómine, supplicántis pópuli cælésti pietáte proséquere: ut et quæ agénda sunt, vídeant, et ad implénda quæ víderint, convaléscant.
text.en: Attend, O Lord, we beseech thee, of thy heavenly mercy, to the desires of thy suppliant people; and grant that they may both perceive what they ought to do, and may have strength to fulfill the same.
